draft.title: Qualities of entrepreneurs
card: Initiative
starting something without being told to. An entrepreneur acts on an idea rather than waiting for someone else.
Creativity
coming up with new ideas or new ways to solve a problem.
Risk and persistence
Entrepreneurs are willing to risk time and money on an idea. They also keep going when things get hard.
Leadership
guiding other people toward a shared vision, which is a clear picture of what the business wants to achieve.
draft.remember: Entrepreneurs tend to show initiative, creativity, risk taking, persistence and leadership.

a.q: Sam sees that no shop near his school sells healthy lunches. Without anyone asking him, he starts a lunch stall. Which quality does this show most clearly?
a.why: Sam acted on his own idea without being told to, which is initiative. Creativity is tempting, but the card describes it as coming up with new ideas or ways to solve a problem, and the main point here is that he started it himself.
a.clue: Nobody asked him to start the stall.

b.q: Priya's online shop sold almost nothing in its first six months. She kept improving her products and tried again each week. Which quality does this show most clearly?
b.why: Persistence means keeping going when things get hard, and Priya kept trying despite poor sales. Initiative is tempting because she runs a shop, but the story is about how she kept going, not about how she started.
b.clue: Look at what she did when sales were poor.

a.q: For months, students at Sam's school say a healthy lunch stall nearby would be good. Sam is the first to set one up. Which quality does he show most clearly?
a.why: Many students had the idea, but Sam was the one who acted on it, which is initiative. Creativity is tempting, but the idea was not new: lots of people had already thought of it.
a.clue: Think about what made Sam different from the others.

b.q: Priya's online shop sold almost nothing in its first six months. She did not give up and tried again each week. Which quality does this show most clearly?
b.why: Persistence means keeping going when things get hard, and Priya kept trying despite poor sales. Initiative is tempting because she runs a shop, but the story is about how she kept going, not about how she started.
b.clue: Look at what she did when sales were poor.
